analysis_purpose: Understand integration points, data models, and capabilities for NYQST bidirectional integration

executive_summary.overview: ServiceNow, Jira/JSM, and Confluence are the dominant platforms where financial services operational work happens. ServiceNow leads in enterprise ITSM/GRC, Jira leads in agile teams/service management, and Confluence leads in knowledge documentation. NYQST must integrate bidirectionally to read operational state and write enriched analysis back.
executive_summary.integration_criticality: CRITICAL - These systems contain the operational telemetry NYQST needs (incidents, changes, tickets, documentation) and are where users work daily. NYQST's copilot must surface contextual assistance within these systems.
executive_summary.key_finding: All three platforms have mature REST APIs and webhook capabilities. Integration is technically feasible. Challenge: capturing tacit knowledge that exists in user actions, not just ticket fields.

overview.market_position: Leader in enterprise ITSM, particularly strong in Fortune 500 financial services
overview.relevance_to_nyqst: Primary operational system for incident management, change management, problem management. Contains CMDB (system relationships), workflow engine. NYQST System 2 must integrate to capture operational reality.

no_tacit_knowledge_capture.gap: ServiceNow/Jira store ticket fields and comments. They don't capture WHY experts made decisions.
no_tacit_knowledge_capture.nyqst_solution: NYQST Copilot asks 'Why did you approve this exception?' → Stores rationale → Builds decision model

no_multi_source_validation.gap: Knowledge articles in ServiceNow/Confluence are static. No mechanism to validate accuracy over time.
no_multi_source_validation.nyqst_solution: Confidence scoring, distributed user validation (Dawid-Skene), SME governance

reactive_not_proactive.gap: ServiceNow/Jira react to incidents. No FMEA-style proactive risk identification.
reactive_not_proactive.nyqst_solution: FMEA on digital twin predicts failures before they occur

no_bayesian_rca.gap: Manual root cause analysis (humans write in ticket). No statistical correlation.
no_bayesian_rca.nyqst_solution: Bayesian RCA identifies statistically significant drivers from historical patterns

no_agent_governance.gap: ServiceNow/Jira have automation (If-Then rules). Not designed for AI agents.
no_agent_governance.nyqst_solution: Agent Operating Model (Identity, Policy, Tools, Coordination, Assurance)

siloed_data.gap: ServiceNow has incidents + CMDB + GRC. Jira has tickets + assets. Data not connected across domains.
siloed_data.nyqst_solution: Digital twin integrates across platforms (ServiceNow + Jira + Celonis + Confluence) into unified operational model
